why: In Darija, deep love lives in the liver, not the heart. It's the tenderest word a grandmother has.

means.en: my dear, apple of my eye

why: You are as precious to me as my own eyes.
Without you, I can't see: you are what makes my world bright.

literal.en: may God keep you for me
literal.fr: que Dieu te garde pour moi
literal.es: que Dios te guarde para mí
literal.it: che Dio ti tenga per me

why: A prayer that you stay in my life: the way elders say 'I love you'.

literal.en: may God be satisfied with you
literal.fr: que Dieu soit satisfait de toi
literal.it: che Dio sia soddisfatto di te

means.en: God bless you, I'm proud of you
means.fr: que Dieu te bénisse, je suis fière de toi
means.es: Dios te bendiga, estoy orgullosa de ti
means.it: Dio ti benedica, sono fiera di te

why: A parent's blessing: the most precious thing a Moroccan child can receive.

literal.fr: la bénédiction de Dieu est sur toi
literal.es: la bendición de Dios está sobre ti
literal.it: la benedizione di Dio è su di te

why: Admiration that also protects you from the evil eye.

literal.en: may God have mercy on your parents
literal.fr: que Dieu fasse miséricorde à tes parents
literal.es: que Dios tenga piedad de tus padres
literal.it: che Dio abbia pietà dei tuoi genitori

why: The warmest 'thank you'. It does NOT mean your parents have died.

literal.en: may God make it easy for you
literal.fr: que Dieu te rende les choses faciles
literal.es: que Dios te lo haga fácil
literal.it: che Dio te la renda facile

why: Said before an exam, a trip, a new job.

literal.en: I felt lonely for you a lot
literal.fr: je me suis sentie seule de toi
literal.it: mi sono sentita sola di te

why: It comes from the word for loneliness: without you, I feel alone.

darija: بلا بيك العيد ما عندو بنة

literal.en: without you Eid has no taste
literal.fr: sans toi l'Aïd n'a pas de goût
literal.es: sin ti el Eid no tiene sabor
literal.it: senza di te l'Eid non ha sapore

means.en: Eid isn't the same without you
means.fr: l'Aïd n'est pas pareil sans toi
means.es: el Eid no es lo mismo sin ti
means.it: l'Eid non è lo stesso senza di te

why: Celebrations only feel complete when the whole family is home.

literal.it: il mio fegato è su di te

means.fr: j'ai mal au cœur pour toi
means.es: me duele el alma por ti
means.it: mi si stringe il cuore per te

why: Worry and tenderness together, for someone far away.
Said to anyone who is sick, or after a haircut or a bath (fresh start).
For new clothes, a new phone, a good meal: may it bring you joy.
A gentle, loving telling-off, usually with a smile.

literal.fr: ce qui est passé est mort
literal.it: ciò che è passato è morto

literal.en: the tar of my country over the honey of other lands
literal.fr: le goudron de mon pays plutôt que le miel des autres
literal.es: el alquitrán de mi tierra antes que la miel de otras
literal.it: il catrame del mio paese piuttosto che il miele degli altri

means.es: como en casa, en ningún sitio

why: Home is home, even at its hardest.
